bio: Erosyn is the electronic music project of Miami-based producer and DJ Connor, previously known as SAP. His music and sets draw on dubstep, grime, drum and bass, psytrance, electro, hardstyle and old-school rave. Scorcher, released November 5, 2026, is available on Spotify, Apple Music and SoundCloud.
booking: For a booking inquiry, include the date, city, venue, capacity and proposed set length. Set details and technical requirements can be discussed by email.
